item.title: Plenty of Blocks 2.1.0 Add-On
item.creator: Owls Cubed
item.description:
2.1.0 Overgrown Update: 600+ new blocks!
- 1600+ vanilla-style blocks and their FUNCTIONAL stair and slab variants!
- Mossy stone, granite, diorite, andesite and deepslate, colored wood and glass, cinnabar and sulfur!
- Slabs place like vanilla ones, stand VERTICALLY and two of them merge into one!
- Real blocks - no entities, no lags!
item.changelog:
+ Added 615 new blocks: mossy stone, colored wood and glass, cinnabar, sulfur, rusty iron!
+ Stairs and slabs for 407 of them!
+ Slabs place like vanilla, merge into full blocks and hold water!
+ Reworked stairs: true collision, torches and rails!
+ Always lit lamps and redstone-powered lamps!

faqEntries.heading: How are the blocks crafted?
faqEntries.content: Most of them are cut in the Stonecutter: put a block in the slot and pick a variant. Blocks that need a recipe are made at the Blocks Craft Station, which you craft from Planks, an Iron Ingot and Cobblestone at a regular Crafting Table.

faqEntries.heading: Where can I see all the recipes?
faqEntries.content: In the Tutorial Book every player gets on their first join. If you lose it, craft another from a Book, Cobblestone and Dirt. Sneak twice while holding it to open Bookmarks.

faqEntries.heading: Do the blocks have stairs and slabs?
faqEntries.content: Most of them do. Cut them in the Stonecutter: 1 block = 1 stairs or 2 slabs. Slabs place like vanilla ones, stand vertically when you sneak, merge into a full block and hold water.

faqEntries.heading: Are these real blocks?
faqEntries.content: Yes. No entities, no lag. They break, sound and waterlog like vanilla blocks.

faqEntries.heading: How do the lamps work?
faqEntries.content: Step on a lamp or power it with redstone. A lamp crafted with a Block of Redstone at the Blocks Craft Station stays lit forever.

faqEntries.heading: How do I find a block's id?
faqEntries.content: Craft the Block ID Checker from a Stick, an Iron Ingot and Glass and use it on any block. It highlights the block and prints its id.

item.howToTitle: Getting Started with Plenty Of Blocks

howToEntries.content:
Every player gets the Tutorial Book on their first join. It covers the pack's recipes: the Stonecutter and the Blocks Craft Station. Lost it? Craft a new one from a Book, Cobblestone and Dirt. Sneak twice while holding the book to open Bookmarks.

Stonecutter: put a block in the slot and pick any of its variants. Most decorative blocks are made this way, and most of them also cut into stairs (1 block = 1 stairs) and slabs (1 block = 2 slabs).

Blocks Craft Station: craft it from Planks, an Iron Ingot and Cobblestone at a regular Crafting Table. It makes the colored planks and stone bricks, screens, gold and lapis bricks, the always lit lamps and other blocks that need a recipe.

Slabs: click the upper or lower half of a side to place the slab on top or at the bottom. Sneak while placing to stand it vertically. Two matching slabs merge into a full block, and sneaking with an empty hand rotates a placed slab.

Lamps: step on a lamp or power it with redstone. A lamp crafted with a Block of Redstone at the Blocks Craft Station stays lit forever.

Block ID Checker: craft it from a Stick, an Iron Ingot and Glass, then use it on any block to see its id. Type /owlscubed_pob:changelog or /owlscubed_pob:updates to see what's new in each update.
